description: Source code for floating point conversion routines, including locale-aware string to double conversion and formatting functions.

methods.name: fpconv_update_locale
methods.description: Updates locale decimal point based on current locale settings.

methods.name: valid_number_character
methods.description: Checks if a character is valid within a number string.

methods.name: strtod_buffer_size
methods.description: Calculates buffer size needed for locale-aware strtod.

methods.name: fpconv_strtod
methods.description: Converts string to double considering locale decimal point.

methods.name: set_number_format
methods.description: Creates printf format string based on precision.

methods.name: fpconv_g_fmt
methods.description: Formats a double into a string with locale-aware decimal point.

methods.name: fpconv_init
methods.description: Initializes locale settings for floating point conversion.
